adjustment_lines_note.name: adjustment_lines_note
adjustment_lines_note.value: "adjustment_lines"."note" IS NULL OR length("adjustment_lines"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 300

adjustments_posted.name: adjustments_posted
adjustments_posted.value:
("adjustments"."status" = 'POSTED') = ("adjustments"."number" IS NOT NULL AND "adjustments"."posted_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "adjustments"."effective_date" IS NOT NULL)

adjustments_note.name: adjustments_note
adjustments_note.value: "adjustments"."note" IS NULL OR length("adjustments"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

audit_log_actor.name: audit_log_actor
audit_log_actor.value:
("audit_log"."actor_kind" = 'SYSTEM' AND "audit_log"."actor_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("audit_log"."actor_kind" <> 'SYSTEM' AND "audit_log"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL)

auth_sessions_revoked_reason.name: auth_sessions_revoked_reason
auth_sessions_revoked_reason.value:
("auth_sessions"."revoked_at" IS NULL) = ("auth_sessions"."revoked_reason" IS NULL)
        AND ("auth_sessions"."revoked_reason" IS NULL OR "auth_sessions"."revoked_reason" IN
          ('LOGOUT', 'LOGOUT_ALL', 'ADMIN', 'PASSWORD_CHANGED', 'USER_DISABLED', 'TOKEN_REUSE'))

bin_moves_posted.name: bin_moves_posted
bin_moves_posted.value:
("bin_moves"."status" = 'POSTED') = ("bin_moves"."number" IS NOT NULL AND "bin_moves"."posted_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "bin_moves"."effective_date" IS NOT NULL)

bin_moves_note.name: bin_moves_note
bin_moves_note.value: "bin_moves"."note" IS NULL OR length("bin_moves"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

bins_name.name: bins_name
bins_name.value: "bins"."name" IS NULL OR length("bins"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 100

customer_addresses_label.name: customer_addresses_label
customer_addresses_label.value: "customer_addresses"."label" IS NULL OR length("customer_addresses"."label") BETWEEN 1 AND 60

customer_addresses_address.name: customer_addresses_address
customer_addresses_address.value: "customer_addresses"."address" IS NULL OR length("customer_addresses"."address") BETWEEN 1 AND 300

customer_addresses_somewhere.name: customer_addresses_somewhere
customer_addresses_somewhere.value: "customer_addresses"."address" IS NOT NULL OR "customer_addresses"."lat" IS NOT NULL

customer_addresses_gps_source.name: customer_addresses_gps_source
customer_addresses_gps_source.value: ("customer_addresses"."lat" IS NULL) = ("customer_addresses"."gps_source" IS NULL) AND ("customer_addresses"."gps_source" IS NULL OR "customer_addresses"."gps_source" IN ('OFFICE', 'FIELD'))

customer_addresses_mongolia.name: customer_addresses_mongolia
customer_addresses_mongolia.value: "customer_addresses"."lat" IS NULL OR ("customer_addresses"."lat" BETWEEN 41.5 AND 52.2 AND "customer_addresses"."lng" BETWEEN 87.7 AND 120)

customer_addresses_note.name: customer_addresses_note
customer_addresses_note.value: "customer_addresses"."note" IS NULL OR length("customer_addresses"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 300

customer_contacts_name.name: customer_contacts_name
customer_contacts_name.value: "customer_contacts"."name" IS NULL OR length("customer_contacts"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 100

customer_contacts_position.name: customer_contacts_position
customer_contacts_position.value: "customer_contacts"."position" IS NULL OR length("customer_contacts"."position") BETWEEN 1 AND 60

customer_contacts_note.name: customer_contacts_note
customer_contacts_note.value: "customer_contacts"."note" IS NULL OR length("customer_contacts"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 300

customer_contacts_someone.name: customer_contacts_someone
customer_contacts_someone.value: "customer_contacts"."name" IS NOT NULL OR "customer_contacts"."phone" IS NOT NULL

customers_reg_no.name: customers_reg_no
customers_reg_no.value: "customers"."reg_no" IS NULL OR length("customers"."reg_no") BETWEEN 1 AND 20

customers_tin_source.name: customers_tin_source
customers_tin_source.value: ("customers"."tin" IS NULL) = ("customers"."tin_source" IS NULL) AND ("customers"."tin_source" IS NULL OR "customers"."tin_source" IN ('LOOKUP', 'MANUAL'))

customers_tax_status.name: customers_tax_status
customers_tax_status.value:
("customers"."tax_status_source" IS NULL) = ("customers"."tax_status_checked_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("customers"."tax_status_source" IS NULL OR "customers"."tax_status_source" IN ('LOOKUP', 'MANUAL'))
        AND ("customers"."tax_status_source" IS NOT NULL OR NOT ("customers"."vat_payer" OR "customers"."city_payer"))

customers_credit_hold_reason.name: customers_credit_hold_reason
customers_credit_hold_reason.value: "customers"."credit_hold_reason" IS NULL OR ("customers"."credit_hold" AND length("customers"."credit_hold_reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 300)

customers_note.name: customers_note
customers_note.value: "customers"."note" IS NULL OR length("customers"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 1000

files_uploaded.name: files_uploaded
files_uploaded.value: ("files"."uploaded_at" IS NULL) = ("files"."sha256" IS NULL) AND ("files"."status" = 'PENDING' OR "files"."uploaded_at" IS NOT NULL)

goods_receipts_posted.name: goods_receipts_posted
goods_receipts_posted.value:
("goods_receipts"."status" = 'POSTED') = ("goods_receipts"."number" IS NOT NULL AND "goods_receipts"."posted_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "goods_receipts"."effective_date" IS NOT NULL AND "goods_receipts"."costing_status" IS NOT NULL)

goods_receipts_costing.name: goods_receipts_costing
goods_receipts_costing.value:
("goods_receipts"."costing_status" IS NULL OR "goods_receipts"."costing_status" IN ('PENDING', 'COSTED'))
        AND "goods_receipts"."costing_version" >= 0
        AND ("goods_receipts"."costing_version" = 0) = ("goods_receipts"."costed_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("goods_receipts"."costing_status" = 'COSTED') = ("goods_receipts"."costing_version" > 0)

goods_receipts_texts.name: goods_receipts_texts
goods_receipts_texts.value:
("goods_receipts"."supplier_doc_no" IS NULL OR length("goods_receipts"."supplier_doc_no") BETWEEN 1 AND 50)
        AND ("goods_receipts"."note" IS NULL OR length("goods_receipts"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 500)

product_locations_levels.name: product_locations_levels
product_locations_levels.value:
("product_locations"."min_qty" IS NULL OR "product_locations"."min_qty" >= 0) AND ("product_locations"."max_qty" IS NULL OR "product_locations"."max_qty" >= 0)
        AND ("product_locations"."min_qty" IS NULL OR "product_locations"."max_qty" IS NULL OR "product_locations"."min_qty" <= "product_locations"."max_qty")

product_units_successor.name: product_units_successor
product_units_successor.value: "product_units"."superseded_by" IS NULL OR "product_units"."superseded_at" IS NOT NULL

product_units_measure_unit.name: product_units_measure_unit
product_units_measure_unit.value: "product_units"."measure_unit" IS NULL OR length("product_units"."measure_unit") BETWEEN 1 AND 50

roles_system_or_custom.name: roles_system_or_custom
roles_system_or_custom.value:
("roles"."is_system" AND "roles"."code" IS NOT NULL AND "roles"."name" IS NULL)
        OR (NOT "roles"."is_system" AND "roles"."code" IS NULL AND length(btrim("roles"."name")) > 0)

stocktake_lines_qty.name: stocktake_lines_qty
stocktake_lines_qty.value:
"stocktake_lines"."expected_qty" >= 0 AND ("stocktake_lines"."counted_qty" IS NULL OR "stocktake_lines"."counted_qty" >= 0)
        AND ("stocktake_lines"."unit_cost" IS NULL OR "stocktake_lines"."unit_cost" >= 0)

stocktakes_approved.name: stocktakes_approved
stocktakes_approved.value:
("stocktakes"."status" = 'APPROVED') = ("stocktakes"."number" IS NOT NULL AND "stocktakes"."posted_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "stocktakes"."effective_date" IS NOT NULL)

stocktakes_started.name: stocktakes_started
stocktakes_started.value:
("stocktakes"."status" <> 'DRAFT' OR "stocktakes"."started_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("stocktakes"."status" NOT IN ('COUNTING', 'REVIEW', 'APPROVED') OR "stocktakes"."started_at" IS NOT NULL)

stocktakes_note.name: stocktakes_note
stocktakes_note.value: "stocktakes"."note" IS NULL OR length("stocktakes"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

supplier_contacts_name.value: "supplier_contacts"."name" IS NULL OR length("supplier_contacts"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 100

supplier_contacts_position.name: supplier_contacts_position
supplier_contacts_position.value: "supplier_contacts"."position" IS NULL OR length("supplier_contacts"."position") BETWEEN 1 AND 60

supplier_contacts_note.name: supplier_contacts_note
supplier_contacts_note.value: "supplier_contacts"."note" IS NULL OR length("supplier_contacts"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 300

supplier_contacts_someone.name: supplier_contacts_someone
supplier_contacts_someone.value: "supplier_contacts"."name" IS NOT NULL OR "supplier_contacts"."phone" IS NOT NULL

suppliers_reg_no.name: suppliers_reg_no
suppliers_reg_no.value: "suppliers"."reg_no" IS NULL OR length("suppliers"."reg_no") BETWEEN 1 AND 20

suppliers_address.name: suppliers_address
suppliers_address.value: "suppliers"."address" IS NULL OR length("suppliers"."address") BETWEEN 1 AND 300

suppliers_bank_name.name: suppliers_bank_name
suppliers_bank_name.value: "suppliers"."bank_name" IS NULL OR length("suppliers"."bank_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 60

suppliers_note.name: suppliers_note
suppliers_note.value: "suppliers"."note" IS NULL OR length("suppliers"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 1000

uoms_measure_unit.value: "uoms"."measure_unit" IS NULL OR length("uoms"."measure_unit") BETWEEN 1 AND 50
